The '''Utrica system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Tamarin sector/Legends|Tamarin sector]], a part of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Utrica system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square N-19.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
